input: Grayscale or RGB; normalized floats 0–1; native classes preserved. RGB spatial/intensity histogram operations use BT.601 luminance, gamma is per channel. Borders replicate. Sobel returns a grayscale edge map. No image pixels are sent to AI.

operations.label: Gamma correction
operations.description: Per-channel power mapping; gamma below 1 brightens normalized midtones, above 1 darkens.

operations.label: Histogram equalization
operations.description: 256-bin cumulative histogram mapping of luminance; constant images unchanged. Can amplify noise.

operations.label: Contrast stretching
operations.description: Clip and rescale normalized input luminance brightness cutoffs, not percentiles. Constant images unchanged.

operations.label: Mean
operations.description: Normalized box average of luminance; smooths variations and can soften edges or spread impulses.

operations.label: Gaussian
operations.description: Normalized spatial Gaussian weights; sigma is in pixels, separate from normalized Gaussian noise standard deviation.

operations.label: Median
operations.description: Neighborhood luminance median; often suppresses isolated impulse noise, can erase small features.

operations.label: Unsharp Mask
operations.description: Luminance plus amount times its Gaussian high-frequency difference. Can amplify noise.

operations.label: Sobel
operations.description: Fixed 3x3 gradient magnitude with fixed scaling; returns a grayscale edge map, not a denoised photograph.

noiseRestrictions: Noise generation is a separate action from clean original, never a sequence operation. RGB channels share samples. Gaussian noise sigma is normalized standard deviation. Seed is an integer 0–4294967295.
